sourceTitle: Take a closer look at art with the Courtauld
originalTitle: Take a closer look at art with the Courtauld
author: Mark Hallett

blocks.text: Today, we are delighted to launch ‘The Art of Looking’, a major expansion of the partnership between Google Arts & Culture and the Courtauld Institute of Art. This collection, which brings together art made across centuries and continents, reflects a shared commitment to opening up art and art history to the broadest possible audience, in keeping with the Courtauld’s commitment to art for all. Additionally, we’re jointly announcing a new artist residency to explore how AI can be used for metadata workflows in cultural institutions.
blocks.zh: 今天,我们...我们很高兴推出《仰视艺术》,Google Arts & Culture与Courtald艺术研究所之间伙伴关系的大规模扩展。这个收藏,它汇集了各世纪和各大洲的艺术,体现了对向尽可能广泛的受众开放艺术和艺术历史的共同承诺,符合Courtauld对艺术为所有人服务的承诺。此外,探索如何将人工智能用于文化机构的元数据工作流程。
blocks.en: Today, we are delighted to launch ‘The Art of Looking’, a major expansion of the partnership between Google Arts & Culture and the Courtauld Institute of Art. This collection, which brings together art made across centuries and continents, reflects a shared commitment to opening up art and art history to the broadest possible audience, in keeping with the Courtauld’s commitment to art for all. Additionally, we’re jointly announcing a new artist residency to explore how AI can be used for metadata workflows in cultural institutions.

blocks.text: The 12 new stories in ‘The Art of Looking’ take on some of the most fundamental questions we can ask about art. In ‘What does art mean?’ Professor Dorothy Price shows how the painter Lubaina Himid used her imagination to rewrite history, while in ‘Who is art for?’ Dr. Tom Stammers traces how artist Rosa Bonheur bypassed the elite gatekeepers of her day to reach a global audience. The stories also take us closer to how artists made the works themselves: zoom into the bold marks of Van Gogh’s reed pens, explore the enduring riddle of Michelangelo’s The Dream, or discover with Dr. Jessica Barker how Claudette Johnson uses the monumental scale of Blues Dance to give her subjects a powerful presence.
blocks.zh: “寻找艺术”的12个新故事讲述了我们可以问到的一些最根本的艺术问题。在“艺术意味着什么”中,多萝西·普莱斯教授展示了画家Lubaina Himid如何利用她的想象力改写历史,在“艺术为谁服务呢?”汤姆·斯塔默斯(英语:Tom Stammers)追踪艺术家罗莎·邦休尔(英语:Rosa Bonheur)如何绕过她时代的精英守门员前往全球观众.这些故事也让我们更接近艺术家们如何自己制作作品:放大梵高的钢笔的粗略印记,探索米开朗基罗的"梦"的持久谜题,或发现博士。杰西卡·巴克尔(Jessica Barker)如何Claude特·约翰逊(Claudette Johnson)利用布鲁斯舞的巨型规模,使她的主题拥有强大的亮相.
blocks.en: The 12 new stories in ‘The Art of Looking’ take on some of the most fundamental questions we can ask about art. In ‘What does art mean?’ Professor Dorothy Price shows how the painter Lubaina Himid used her imagination to rewrite history, while in ‘Who is art for?’ Dr. Tom Stammers traces how artist Rosa Bonheur bypassed the elite gatekeepers of her day to reach a global audience. The stories also take us closer to how artists made the works themselves: zoom into the bold marks of Van Gogh’s reed pens, explore the enduring riddle of Michelangelo’s The Dream, or discover with Dr. Jessica Barker how Claudette Johnson uses the monumental scale of Blues Dance to give her subjects a powerful presence.

blocks.text: Édouard Manet, “A Bar at the Folies-Bergère,” 1882
blocks.zh: 爱德华·马内特,1882年,在贝尔热尔圣殿律师事务所举行
blocks.en: Édouard Manet, “A Bar at the Folies-Bergère,” 1882

blocks.text: Manet’s last major painting depicts Suzon, a barmaid at the Folies-Bergère, who seems to embody a sense of detached melancholy at the heart of one of Paris’s most fashionable music halls. Much of the painting’s unsettling power lies in its mirror: ignoring normal perspective, Manet shifts the barmaid’s reflection to the right, so that she appears to be serving a male customer even while she gazes out, enigmatically, towards the viewer.
blocks.zh: 马内特的最后一幅主要画描绘了苏松,博尔盖尔的女酒保,他们似乎将一种离散的忧郁情绪表现在巴黎最时髦的音乐厅之一的中心。这幅画的许多令人不安的力量都在于它的镜子:无视正常视角,Manet将女酒保的思考转移到右边,所以她似乎在为一个男性顾客服务 即使她凝视,神秘地说,向观者.
blocks.en: Manet’s last major painting depicts Suzon, a barmaid at the Folies-Bergère, who seems to embody a sense of detached melancholy at the heart of one of Paris’s most fashionable music halls. Much of the painting’s unsettling power lies in its mirror: ignoring normal perspective, Manet shifts the barmaid’s reflection to the right, so that she appears to be serving a male customer even while she gazes out, enigmatically, towards the viewer.

blocks.text: Vincent Van Gogh, “Self-Portrait with Bandaged Ear,” 1889
blocks.zh: 文森特・范高,1889年,“用带状耳朵的自画像”,
blocks.en: Vincent Van Gogh, “Self-Portrait with Bandaged Ear,” 1889

blocks.text: Painted in Arles in January 1889, shortly after Van Gogh had cut off most of his left ear during a severe mental crisis, this self-portrait is at once a record of vulnerability and powerful proof of his determination to keep painting. Behind him, a canvas just begun and a Japanese print, one of his greatest sources of inspiration, point to the ambitions that sustained him.
blocks.zh: 1889年1月在阿列斯画作,在梵高在一次严重的精神危机中 割下他大部分左耳后不久这幅自画像一瞬间就成了他脆弱不堪的记录,有力地证明了他坚持绘画的决心.画布刚刚开始 和日本的指纹,他最大的灵感来源之一,说明他坚持的野心。
blocks.en: Painted in Arles in January 1889, shortly after Van Gogh had cut off most of his left ear during a severe mental crisis, this self-portrait is at once a record of vulnerability and powerful proof of his determination to keep painting. Behind him, a canvas just begun and a Japanese print, one of his greatest sources of inspiration, point to the ambitions that sustained him.

blocks.text: Claudette Johnson, a prominent figure of the British Black Arts Movement, made “Blues Dance” for her 2023 exhibition at the Courtauld Gallery, drawing on her memories of the Blue Beat dance scene of the 1980s. Its fluid, expressive lines and rich color celebrate music, movement, and joy, while its epic scale gives the dancing figure a commanding presence.
blocks.zh: Claude特·约翰逊,英国黑人艺术运动的著名人物,为她在Courtald画廊的2023年展览制作“蓝色舞蹈”,以她对1980年代的蓝碧舞场景的回忆来画画.它的液体,表达的线条和丰富的颜色 庆祝音乐,移动,和欢乐,而它的史诗性尺度 给了舞者一个命令性的存在。
blocks.en: Claudette Johnson, a prominent figure of the British Black Arts Movement, made “Blues Dance” for her 2023 exhibition at the Courtauld Gallery, drawing on her memories of the Blue Beat dance scene of the 1980s. Its fluid, expressive lines and rich color celebrate music, movement, and joy, while its epic scale gives the dancing figure a commanding presence.

blocks.text: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, “Landscape with the Flight into Egypt,” 1563
blocks.zh: 长老彼得·布鲁格尔,“与飞入埃及有关的景观,”1563年
blocks.en: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, “Landscape with the Flight into Egypt,” 1563

blocks.text: Bruegel sets the biblical story of the Holy Family’s flight into a grand, sweeping landscape, in which human drama is almost absorbed by the natural world. The small, vulnerable figures of Mary, Joseph, and the infant Jesus are tucked into this panoramic scene, emphasizing the power and scale of their surroundings.
blocks.zh: Bruegel把圣经故事 神圣家庭的飞行变成了一个宏伟的,广阔的风景,在其中,人类戏剧几乎被自然世界吸收.{\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}这个小的 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}小的玛丽的脆弱人物,约瑟夫,和婴儿耶稣 被困在这个全景,强调其周围的力量和规模。
blocks.en: Bruegel sets the biblical story of the Holy Family’s flight into a grand, sweeping landscape, in which human drama is almost absorbed by the natural world. The small, vulnerable figures of Mary, Joseph, and the infant Jesus are tucked into this panoramic scene, emphasizing the power and scale of their surroundings.

blocks.text: Founded in 1932 as the first institution in the UK devoted to the study of art history, the Courtauld is today an internationally renowned center for teaching and research, as well as a major public gallery. It is home to the largest community of art historians and conservators in the UK, and its scholars have long been pioneers in using technology, from X-rays to chemistry, to reveal what lies beneath the surface of works of art. Making its collection — and the research behind it — accessible to audiences across the globe remains a central priority.
blocks.zh: 成立于1932年,是英国第一个致力于艺术史研究的机构,科托尔德今天是一个国际知名的教学和研究中心,以及一个大型公共画廊。它是英国最大的艺术历史学家和保守主义者的家园,它的学者们在利用技术方面 早已是先锋,从X光到化学,以揭示艺术品的表面之下。使全球各地的受众都能查阅其汇编及其背后的研究,仍然是一个核心优先事项。
blocks.en: Founded in 1932 as the first institution in the UK devoted to the study of art history, the Courtauld is today an internationally renowned center for teaching and research, as well as a major public gallery. It is home to the largest community of art historians and conservators in the UK, and its scholars have long been pioneers in using technology, from X-rays to chemistry, to reveal what lies beneath the surface of works of art. Making its collection — and the research behind it — accessible to audiences across the globe remains a central priority.

blocks.text: Google Arts & Culture first partnered with The Courtauld in 2022, using Google’s Art Camera to capture 16 iconic works in remarkable depth and detail. For the first time, anyone, anywhere could follow the extraordinary play of Manet’s brushstrokes across the surface of “A Bar at the Folies-Bergère”.
blocks.zh: Google Arts & Culture最早于2022年与The Courtauld合作,利用Google的艺术相机,以显著的深度和细节捕捉16部标志性作品.这是第一次,任何一个人,在任何地方都可以追随马奈特在 " 博尔盖尔的一家酒吧 " 的表面所演奏的非凡的笔杆。
blocks.en: Google Arts & Culture first partnered with The Courtauld in 2022, using Google’s Art Camera to capture 16 iconic works in remarkable depth and detail. For the first time, anyone, anywhere could follow the extraordinary play of Manet’s brushstrokes across the surface of “A Bar at the Folies-Bergère”.

blocks.text: In addition to The Art of Looking, the Courtauld and Google Arts & Culture are announcing a new artist residency to explore how AI can unlock the Courtauld’s extensive photographic collections. It lays the foundation for making these images searchable and connecting them to learning curricula worldwide.
blocks.zh: 除了"寻找的艺术"之外,Courtald和Google Arts & Culture正在宣布一个新的艺术家居住权,以探索AI如何能够解锁Courtald的大量照片收藏。它为这些图像的搜索奠定了基础,并将它们与全世界的学习课程联系起来。
blocks.en: In addition to The Art of Looking, the Courtauld and Google Arts & Culture are announcing a new artist residency to explore how AI can unlock the Courtauld’s extensive photographic collections. It lays the foundation for making these images searchable and connecting them to learning curricula worldwide.

blocks.text: We look forward to seeing how these tools can open up art education to new audiences and create even more immersive ways of learning. Explore The Art of Looking today at goo.gle/courtauld.
blocks.zh: 我们期待着看到这些工具如何能够向新的受众开放艺术教育,并创造出更沉浸的学习方式。探索今天在goo.gle/courtauld的艺术。
blocks.en: We look forward to seeing how these tools can open up art education to new audiences and create even more immersive ways of learning. Explore The Art of Looking today at goo.gle/courtauld.
